errorCodes.meaning: The requester is not a member of this community.

Ext.description: Vendor-namespaced extension object per SPEC.md §4.5.1. Each immediate key MUST be a reverse-DNS namespace; structure under each namespace is opaque to the framework.
Ext.title: Ext

Reset.description: An administrator's reset of this member's binding, not yet completed by an enrolment under a new identifier.

open.description: True when `waitingOn` is empty: the next enrolment may present a new identifier, and the community binds it.

resetAt.description: When the administrator reset the binding.

waitingOn.description: The labels the recorded identifier enrolled under that the community still accepts, at the time of this answer. A new identifier is refused until this is empty.

Reset.title: Reset

Response.description: The requester's own binding. `id` is present exactly when `bound` is true.

bound.description: Whether the community holds an identifier for this member. False for a member who has never enrolled.

enrolledLabels.description: The vetter class labels this member has enrolled under with the recorded identifier, oldest first. Empty when not bound.

id.description: The PCS identifier recorded at this member's first enrolment, multibase base58btc. Present if and only if `bound` is true; a consumer treats `bound: true` without `id` as not bound. While a reset is pending it is still the recorded one: enrolling with it again cancels the reset.
